REQ_AS_BUILT_PE_ENDORSEMENT_E002.description: The identity and license number of the PE who would endorse the project were unresolved because the previously supplied license number appeared to show different information in the Nevada registry.

execution.observed_behavior: The freelancer reports delivery of the letter with the PE stamp applied.
The delivered stamped letter retained the placeholder “engineer name” in its signature block instead of identifying the actual engineer.
The stamped letter displayed the date as 18/07/2026 rather than the required US-format date 07/18/2026.
The client confirmed that the corrected stamped letter looked good after the signer-name and date-format issues were addressed.
The downstream client reviewed and accepted the stamped note as good.
